title: Sordland/Turn05/Personal_MonicaTalk
description: Monica relationship confrontation leading to maintaining of normal husband wife relationship or a rift in the marriage. The first lady will be announcing her support for the womans suffrage.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It felt like eternity since the Ben..."
entries.dialogueText: It felt like eternity since the Benfi Festival. Had it really only been less than 24 hours?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was at home now, drinking an afte..."
entries.dialogueText: I was at home now, drinking an afternoon coffee on my balcony. A stack of newspapers lay by my side. I picked them up one by one, reading and re-reading the articles about the festival.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I started regretting my decisions...."
entries.dialogueText: I started regretting my decisions. Regardless, it was too late now. The damage was done.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Some of the newspapers were mercile..."
entries.dialogueText: Some of the newspapers were merciless against Monica for interrupting Curtan during his speech. A few even called for her to be barred from political matters. Others expressed their support.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Some of the papers came out in full..."
entries.dialogueText: Some of the papers came out in full support of the First Lady for her brave speech. Others took Curtan's side.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In any event, I was relieved that t..."
entries.dialogueText: In any event, I was relieved that the incident hadn't reflected too badly on me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As expected, the headlines were mer..."
entries.dialogueText: As expected, the headlines were merciless. I was compared to a dictator for my intolerance of Curtan's opinion. Some even likened me to Tarquin Soll. The knowledge that Curtan would soon be fired provided little comfort.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As expected, Marcel delivered. Ther..."
entries.dialogueText: As expected, Marcel delivered. There was only a second-page article about Curtan Leste behaving deplorably and leaving the festival in disgrace.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But my relief was short-lived. Marc..."
entries.dialogueText: But my relief was short-lived. Marcel was effective, but he was also a double-edged sword. I couldn't help but think that if someone offered him a better deal, he'd turn on me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As expected, Curtan delivered. The..."
entries.dialogueText: As expected, Curtan delivered. The news was all about his apology for his disgraceful behavior during the festival.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was putting the last newspaper do..."
entries.dialogueText: I was putting the last newspaper down as Monica joined me on the balcony.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was putting the last newspaper do..."
entries.dialogueText: I was putting the last newspaper down as Monica joined me on the balcony.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was putting the last newspaper do..."
entries.dialogueText: I was putting the last newspaper down as Monica joined me on the balcony.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was putting the last newspaper do..."
entries.dialogueText: I was putting the last newspaper down as Monica joined me on the balcony.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Listen. Can we talk for a bit?""
entries.dialogueText: “Listen. Can we talk for a bit?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“So, you've seen the news?”"
entries.dialogueText: “So, you've seen the news?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“If this is about the news, I know..."
entries.dialogueText: “If this is about the news, I know what you are going to say.”
entries.menuText: “If this is about the news, I know what you are going to say.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Of course. What is it?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Of course. What is it?”
entries.menuText: “Of course. What is it?”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I gestured towards the chair next t..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured towards the chair next to me.
entries.menuText: Gesture for her to sit down.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I just wanted to thank you for sup..."
entries.dialogueText: “I just wanted to thank you for supporting me, and apologize for creating such a spectacle.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""All I wanted was to bring the peop..."
entries.dialogueText: "All I wanted was to bring the people of Sordland together, the way you're able to. But not like this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes were getting moist. A sing..."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes were getting moist. A single tear fell onto the newsprint.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I leaned forward and wiped her tear..."
entries.dialogueText: I leaned forward and wiped her tears from her eyes. She clasped my hand to her face.
entries.menuText: Wipe her tears away.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's okay. Everything is under con..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's okay. Everything is under control.”
entries.menuText: “It's okay. Everything is under control.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“If you are going to succeed in thi..."
entries.dialogueText: “If you are going to succeed in this, you have to be stronger. I know you can be.”
entries.menuText: “If you are going to succeed in this, you have to be stronger. I know you can be.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I did warn you. But you were alway..."
entries.dialogueText: “I did warn you. But you were always stubborn.”
entries.menuText: “I did warn you. But you were always stubborn.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Oh, Anton.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Oh, Anton.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I know. I'm sorry. But you are rig..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know. I'm sorry. But you are right.”

entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes filled with gratitude. I c..."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes filled with gratitude. I could see she'd slept as little as I had since the festival.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I am stubborn.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I am stubborn.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“One more thing. You know how stubb..."
entries.dialogueText: “One more thing. You know how stubborn I am.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Monica, I know. We can talk about..."
entries.dialogueText: "Monica, I know. We can talk about this--”
entries.menuText: "Monica, I know. We can talk about this--”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What news?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What news?”
entries.menuText: “What news?”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I did not reply."
entries.dialogueText: I did not reply.
entries.menuText: Do not reply.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“What is there to talk about? I'm a..."
entries.dialogueText: “What is there to talk about? I'm a disgrace with no support from my husband. It says so right here.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Here, I have it memorized: First L..."
entries.dialogueText: “Here, I have it memorized: First Lady disgraced. No support from her husband.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You shouldn't have spoken out.”"
entries.dialogueText: "You shouldn't have spoken out.”
entries.menuText: "You shouldn't have spoken out.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She grabbed one of the newspapers f..."
entries.dialogueText: She grabbed one of the newspapers from the top of the stack and started reading out what a columnist wrote.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“With her shameful outburst at Anri..."
entries.dialogueText: “With her shameful outburst at Anrica mayor Curtan Leste, First Lady Monica Rayne once again proved that politics is an area best left to gentlemen."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“The President provided no support...."
entries.dialogueText: “The President provided no support."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“You can't even stand Leste, and yo..."
entries.dialogueText: “You can't even stand Leste, and you took his side! While making me look like a fool!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She started ripping the newspaper t..."
entries.dialogueText: She started ripping the newspaper to shreds.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“After all these years by your side..."
entries.dialogueText: “After all these years by your side, playing the doting wife...”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“You know... my mother was right ab..."
entries.dialogueText: “You know... my mother was right about you.”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “Darling, believe me. My hands were tied.”

entries.speaker: Monica

entries.speaker: Monica

entries.dialogueText: “You...You betrayed me.”

entries.speaker: Monica

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: I handed her my agreement with Curtan. She started reading it, eyes wide with disbelief.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sometimes you have to make sacrifi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sometimes you have to make sacrifices for the good of the country. You've got to learn that if you want to enter politics.”
entries.menuText: “Sometimes you have to make sacrifices for the good of the country. You've got to learn that if you want to enter politics.”

entries.title: Monica: "“But why did the sacrifice have to..."
entries.dialogueText: “But why did the sacrifice have to be me? Never mind. You had your reasons."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'll give you one more chance. But..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'll give you one more chance. But this time I won't tolerate it if it meddles with how I run the country.”
entries.menuText: “I'll give you one more chance. But this time I won't tolerate it if it meddles with how I run the country.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You always have my support. I fail..."

entries.menuText: “You always have my support. I failed you this time -- it won't happen again."

entries.speaker: Monica

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I-- Thank you.”"

entries.menuText: “No. I was right not to let you speak at the festival. Next time, I won't bring you at all."

entries.dialogueText: “Far be it from me to disagree with the President."

entries.speaker: Monica

entries.dialogueText: "I see. That's where your priorities lie."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“But know this. I will never forget..."
entries.dialogueText: “But know this. I will never forget about what you did. Never!”

entries.menuText: “I was afraid I'd make you look weak by stepping in.”

entries.dialogueText: “I-- I suppose I can appreciate that.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“There is another chance, you know...."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: There was a brief silence.

entries.dialogueText: "I will never forget how you let me down. Never!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her words repeated in my head again..."
entries.dialogueText: Her words repeated in my head again and again.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Yes, it's nothing. Your papa and I..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, it's nothing. Your papa and I were just having a little disagreement. Come on, Deana. Lets go to the kitchen.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I thought to myself..."
entries.dialogueText: I thought to myself...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A noise came from the balcony door...."
entries.dialogueText: A noise came from the balcony door. We both turned our heads to see Deana standing there.

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: "“Mama, I'm hungry.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mama, I'm hungry.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Lets go to the kitchen, baby. We'l..."
entries.dialogueText: “Lets go to the kitchen, baby. We'll make Papa the best snack ever!"

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: "“Yeah!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yeah!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They left the balcony and returned..."
entries.dialogueText: They left the balcony and returned half an hour later with a large cookie. Deana had written my name in icing on it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I sipped my coffee and nibbled t..."
entries.dialogueText: As I sipped my coffee and nibbled the cookie, I thought that I had made the right choice.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Things were going to get harder, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: Things were going to get harder, but at least my life at home was somewhat...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Peaceful."
entries.dialogueText: Peaceful.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I'm not sure I can forgive you for..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm not sure I can forgive you for this, Anton.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“But you do have one more chance to..."
entries.dialogueText: “But you do have one more chance to make it up to me. And offer your *real* support."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a noise from the balcony..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a noise from the balcony door. We both turned our heads to see Deana standing there, a confused look in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: "“Papa. Mama. Why are you fighting?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Papa. Mama. Why are you fighting?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's nothing. We were just... talk..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's nothing. We were just... talking about work.”
entries.menuText: “It's nothing. We were just... talking about work.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica pierced me with her eyes one..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica pierced me with her eyes one more time as they left the balcony and closed the door behind them.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Your father is right. We were just..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your father is right. We were just having a little disagreement. Come on, Deana. Lets go to the kitchen.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I did not reply."
entries.dialogueText: I did not reply.
entries.menuText: Stay silent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her words repeated in my head, agai..."
entries.dialogueText: Her words repeated in my head, again and again.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“It's nothing. Your papa and I were..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's nothing. Your papa and I were just having a little disagreement. Come on, Deana. Lets go to the kitchen.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "“I will never forget about what you..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will never forget about what you did. Never!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What's that supposed to mean?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What's that supposed to mean?”
entries.menuText: “What's that supposed to mean?”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Oh, you know what it means.""
entries.dialogueText: “Oh, you know what it means."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked down at the pieces of to..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked down at the pieces of torn newspaper.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few of the papers came out in sup..."
entries.dialogueText: A few of the papers came out in support of the First Lady for her brave speech, while denigrating Curtan for his rude interruption. But most agreed that Monica had humiliated herself.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could only imagine what would hav..."
entries.dialogueText: I could only imagine what would have happened if I had let her continue.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nearly all of them agreed that the..."
entries.dialogueText: Nearly all of them agreed that the First Lady had acquitted herself very well following the interruption.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Anton, how could you? You knew how..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anton, how could you? You knew how important that speech was to me, and you let that dinosaur Leste make a mockery of me and my cause!"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Anton, how could you? First you de..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anton, how could you? First you deny me the opportunity to speak at the festival, then you let that dinosaur Leste make a mockery of me and my cause!"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“What began as an unexpectedly impa..."
entries.dialogueText: “What began as an unexpectedly impassioned plea for ladies' rights at the opening of the Benfi Festival turned into a circus sideshow as First Lady Monica Rayne failed to counter the rightful objections of the Mayor of Anrica, Curtan Leste."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No. I was wrong to have let you sp..."
entries.dialogueText: “No. I was wrong to have let you speak at the festival. I won't make the same mistake again."
entries.menuText: “No. I was wrong to have let you speak at the festival. I won't make the same mistake again."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""All that business with Leste at th..."
entries.dialogueText: "All that business with Leste at the festival distracted from my real message. I'm still not giving up on women's rights, Anton."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""When I gave that speech, I saw hop..."
entries.dialogueText: "When I gave that speech, I saw hope in the eyes of all the women in the audience. This is the right path for me, Anton."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I know this isn't an urgent issue..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know this isn't an urgent issue for you. But it's vital to me."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I know this is something you're pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know this is something you're passionate about as well. Can I count on you?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Good.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Oh, Anton. This means so much to m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, Anton. This means so much to me!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica hugged me tightly, and I fel..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica hugged me tightly, and I felt some of the past day's tension melt away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica gave me a quick hug."
entries.dialogueText: Monica gave me a quick hug.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm rather busy, but all right.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'm rather busy, but all right.”
entries.menuText: “I'm rather busy, but all right.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Of course. What is it?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Of course. What is it?”
entries.menuText: “Of course. what is it?”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I gestured towards the chair next t..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured towards the chair next to me. She sat down.
entries.menuText: Gesture for her to sit down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica sat and picked up the neares..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica sat and picked up the nearest newspaper. She pointed to a particularly insulting headline on the front page.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica sat and picked up the neares..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica sat and picked up the nearest newspaper. She flipped it open to the article about Curtan's apology.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I've been reading the papers, too...."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been reading the papers, too. I'm happy the confrontation with Curtan didn't seem to have caused much damage. But it could have gone so much worse."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I'm glad that beast admitted he wa..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm glad that beast admitted he was in the wrong. But it could very easily have gone another way.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I never in a million years would h..."
entries.dialogueText: “I never in a million years would have wished for this, Anton.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's okay. I've had Curtan fired...."
entries.dialogueText: “It's okay. I've had Curtan fired. That's the last of our troubles with him."
entries.menuText: “It's okay. I've had Curtan fired. That's the last of our troubles with him."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica stood up."
entries.dialogueText: Monica stood up.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""You were right. Gloria was right...."
entries.dialogueText: "You were right. Gloria was right. I made myself look like an idiot and damaged the very cause I was fighting for."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“With the President providing no su..."
entries.dialogueText: “With the President providing no support, her challenge to Leste was quickly defeated."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Powerless to defend herself from t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Powerless to defend herself from this challenge, she turned to the President, who provided no support."
